counties: Cumberland, Fentress, Macon, Overton, Putnam, Smith, Warren, and White Counties

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Middle Tennessee AVA of about 2.18 million acres in eight counties, around Cookeville and McMinnville. It was created in 2024 and has 55 vineyards on over 71 acres, supplying nine wineries.
